notes: Transcribed from Unbound Species Mechanics Desktop App Reference document.
Every species is built from: biology_type + morphotype + core_traits + additional_traits + size + diet.
This system is universe-agnostic. Biology types and morphotypes define the framework.
Named species (e.g. Ciretose world) populate specific instances of this framework.
Fields marked NEEDS_DEFINITION are explicitly flagged in the source document as incomplete.
Trait mechanical effects are defined in the traits section and referenced by id throughout.
Equipment slots are determined by morphotype, not by species directly.
Species base pools: 8 HP, 8 SP, 8 MP per rules. Trait and stat bonuses stack on top.

tiny.name: Tiny
tiny.description: Insects, small creatures. Rarely playable without traits.

medium.name: Medium
medium.notes: Baseline. All stat formulas assume Medium unless noted.

acid_spit.name: Acid Spit
acid_spit.effect: NEEDS_DEFINITION: ranged acid attack, likely deals acid damage on hit.

antlers.name: Antlers
antlers.effect: Natural weapon. Can be used as a Reach melee attack. May grant bonus to Block or Shove.

attuned.name: Attuned
attuned.effect: Innate connection to magical energies. Likely grants starting Affinity or bonus to Affinity rolls.

blessed.name: Blessed
blessed.effect: Divine resonance. Likely grants bonus to saves vs unholy or shadow effects.

bristles.name: Bristles
bristles.effect: Melee attackers take minor piercing damage on hit. Bonus to resist grapple.

cold_blooded.name: Cold-Blooded
cold_blooded.effect: Penalty in cold environments. Bonus in warm. NEEDS_DEFINITION: specific modifiers.

defense.name: Defense
defense.effect: Passive defensive bonus. NEEDS_DEFINITION: specific value.

dense_bones.name: Dense Bones
dense_bones.effect: +BDY to carry capacity calculations. Penalty to swimming. Resistant to knockback.

elemental_fire.name: Elemental (Fire)
elemental_fire.effect: Innate fire affinity. Likely grants Fire Resistance and access to Fire Affinity without separate purchase.

energy_absorbing_heat.name: Energy Absorbing (Heat)
energy_absorbing_heat.effect: Absorb heat-based damage. NEEDS_DEFINITION: specific absorption formula.

exoskeleton.name: Exoskeleton
exoskeleton.effect: Natural armor. Grants flat DR vs physical damage. Does not stack with worn heavy armor (replaces instead).

fang_claw.name: Fang/Claw
fang_claw.effect: Natural unarmed weapons. Attacks deal piercing or slashing damage without a weapon. Grants Unarmed Attack proficiency.

fur.name: Fur
fur.effect: Cold resistance. Penalty in extreme heat. Cosmetic variation.

heat_resist.name: Heat Resist
heat_resist.effect: Reduce fire and heat damage taken. NEEDS_DEFINITION: specific value.

high_perception.name: High Perception
high_perception.effect: +R to all Awareness and Notice checks. NEEDS_DEFINITION: whether this is a passive or active bonus.

hollow_bones.name: Hollow Bones
hollow_bones.effect: Reduced body weight for flight calculations. -BDY penalty to resist knockback and grapple.

horn.name: Horn
horn.effect: Natural weapon. Bonus to Bash attacks. Can be used as Charge attack.

hooves.name: Hooves
hooves.effect: Natural weapon (kick). Bonus SPD on open terrain. Penalty to climbing.

memory.name: Memory
memory.effect: Enhanced recall. Bonus to remembering locations, faces, information. NEEDS_DEFINITION: mechanical expression.

parasitic.name: Parasitic
parasitic.effect: NEEDS_DEFINITION: feeding mechanic and associated bonuses/penalties.

poison_resist.name: Poison Resist
poison_resist.effect: Reduce poison damage and resist Poisoned status application.

rapid_regen.name: Rapid Regen
rapid_regen.effect: +HPR per rank. Likely doubles baseline HPR or adds flat HPR.

scales.name: Scales
scales.effect: Natural armor vs slashing and piercing. Less effective vs bludgeoning.

shell.name: Shell
shell.effect: High natural DR. Can retract into shell for defensive stance. NEEDS_DEFINITION: retraction mechanics.

thick_hide.name: Thick Hide
thick_hide.effect: Flat DR vs physical damage. Stacks with worn armor up to a limit.

tusks.name: Tusks
tusks.effect: Natural weapon. Bonus to Bash and Charge attacks.

aerodynamic.name: Aerodynamic
aerodynamic.effect: Reduced air resistance. Bonus to SPD and maneuverability during flight or running.

aerokinetic_membranes.name: Aerokinetic Membranes
aerokinetic_membranes.effect: Wing-like membranes allowing gliding. NEEDS_DEFINITION: glide ratio and distance.

amphibious.name: Amphibious
amphibious.effect: Can breathe both air and water. No movement penalty in water.

avian_wings.name: Avian Wings
avian_wings.effect: Full flight capability. SPD in air = Size SPD * FPR. Requires FPR >= 1.0 for sustained flight.

burrower.name: Burrower
burrower.effect: Can dig through soft terrain. Movement speed underground at reduced rate. NEEDS_DEFINITION: dig speed.

digitigrade.name: Digitigrade
digitigrade.effect: Walks on toes. +SPD. Unique footwear slot requirement.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.effect: Reduced SP cost for sustained movement. Bonus to travel speed over long distances.

gas_bladder.name: Gas Bladder
gas_bladder.effect: Internal buoyancy organ. Bonus to swimming. Some variants allow limited hovering.

heavy_set.name: Heavy-Set
heavy_set.effect: Increased carry capacity. Penalty to SPD. Bonus to resist knockback and Shove.

groundsense.name: Groundsense
groundsense.effect: Detect vibrations through ground contact. Perceive movement within range even when blind.

heat_vision.name: Heat Vision
heat_vision.effect: See heat signatures. No penalty in darkness. Penalty vs cold-blooded or disguised targets.

keen_hearing.name: Keen Hearing
keen_hearing.effect: +R to Notice checks involving sound. Penalty from loud noise or silence effects.

keen_sight.name: Keen Sight
keen_sight.effect: +R to Notice checks involving vision. Bonus to ranged attack at long range.

keen_smell.name: Keen Smell
keen_smell.effect: +R to tracking and detecting hidden creatures. Cannot be fooled by disguise alone.

lateral_line.name: Lateral Line
lateral_line.effect: Aquatic pressure sense. Detect movement in water within range. Replaces sight in murky water.

aggressive.name: Aggressive
aggressive.effect: Bonus to initiative and first attack. Penalty to social rolls vs non-aggressive cultures.

ambusher.name: Ambusher
ambusher.effect: Bonus to attacks from stealth or surprise. Crit range expands when undetected.

broad_back.name: Broad Back
broad_back.effect: Increased carry capacity. Bonus to mounted rider stability.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.effect: Passive concealment in natural environments. Bonus to Stealth rolls in matching terrain.

fearsome_displays.name: Fearsome Displays
fearsome_displays.effect: Intimidation bonus. May inflict Feared status on failed save. Costs SP or AP.

flighty.name: Flighty
flighty.effect: Bonus to flee or disengage. Penalty to hold ground or tank roles.

herd_mentality.name: Herd Mentality
herd_mentality.effect: Bonus when allies are nearby. Penalty when isolated. NEEDS_DEFINITION: specific modifiers.

hibernate.name: Hibernate
hibernate.effect: Can enter deep rest for extended periods. Full HP/SP/MP restore on wake. NEEDS_DEFINITION: in-game duration rules.

hive_mind.name: Hive-Mind
hive_mind.effect: Shared sensory information with others of same type within range. NEEDS_DEFINITION: range and scope.

ink_cloud.name: Ink Cloud
ink_cloud.effect: Release obscuring cloud in water or air. Concealment for self and nearby allies.

ki_sight.name: Ki-Sight
ki_sight.effect: Perceive life energy and magical aura. See through illusions. NEEDS_DEFINITION: specific effect.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.effect: Copy sounds, voices, or appearances. Bonus to Deception using mimicry.

pack_coordination.name: Pack Coordination
pack_coordination.effect: Bonus to attacks when flanking with allies. Bonus to group movement.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.effect: Charge attack with bonus damage. Knocks target Prone on hit. NEEDS_DEFINITION: AP/SP cost.

rooter.name: Rooter
rooter.effect: Can dig for food and materials. Bonus to Foraging. Bonus to finding buried objects.

spore_cloud.name: Spore Cloud
spore_cloud.effect: Release spores in radius. Effects vary: may cause Confused, Poisoned, or sleep. NEEDS_DEFINITION: specific status.

stealthy.name: Stealthy
stealthy.effect: +R to Stealth rolls. May move at full speed without Stealth penalty.

territorial.name: Territorial
territorial.effect: Bonus to defense rolls when protecting a claimed area. Penalty to retreat from defended zone.

tool_user.name: Tool User
tool_user.effect: Can use standard equipment and tools. Required for most weapon and armor types. Standard for humanoids.

trap_setter.name: Trap Setter
trap_setter.effect: Bonus to setting and detecting traps. Bonus to Engineering or Foraging for trap materials.

tribal.name: Tribal
tribal.effect: Bonus to social rolls within tribal culture. Access to tribal knowledge networks.

trunk.name: Trunk
trunk.effect: Prehensile appendage. Can manipulate objects without hands. Bonus to grapple. Separate equipment slot.

venomous.name: Venomous
venomous.effect: Natural attacks inflict Poisoned on hit. NEEDS_DEFINITION: stack count and save DC.

aerial_roots.name: Aerial Roots
aerial_roots.effect: Can anchor to surfaces. Bonus to climbing and resist knockback.

alkaloid_compounds.name: Alkaloid Compounds
alkaloid_compounds.effect: Natural toxins in body. Melee attackers risk Poisoned. May be harvested as alchemical ingredient.

capitula.name: Flower Head (Capitula)
capitula.effect: NEEDS_DEFINITION: sensory or social mechanical effect.

climbing_vines.name: Climbing Vines
climbing_vines.effect: Can use vine-based grapple or restraint. Bonus to climbing.

hollow_stems.name: Hollow Stems
hollow_stems.effect: Can store liquids internally. Bonus to Alchemy involving liquid reagents.

mycorrhizal_symbiosis.name: Mycorrhizal Symbiosis
mycorrhizal_symbiosis.effect: Connection to fungal networks. Detect other plant life. Share information through root contact.

nitrogen_fixing_roots.name: Nitrogen-Fixing Roots
nitrogen_fixing_roots.effect: Can fertilize terrain. Bonus to growing food or herbs in adjacent area.

rapid_growth.name: Rapid Growth
rapid_growth.effect: Heal faster when in sunlight or near water. Accelerated natural regeneration.

thorny_stems.name: Thorny Stems
thorny_stems.effect: Melee attackers take piercing damage on grapple or unarmed strike. Natural armor vs grabs.

bipedal_beast.name: Bipedal Beast
bipedal_beast.notes: Heavier build. Natural weapons. May have unique head/hoof slot.

tauric.name: Tauric
tauric.notes: Upper humanoid torso on quadruped base. Cannot use climbing gear easily.

hexapod.name: Hexapod
hexapod.notes: Six-limbed. Complex slot system. Wings occupy back slot.

arachnid.name: Arachnid
arachnid.notes: Climbing ability. Low jump height. Optional arm slots if species has them.

scorpoid.name: Scorpoid
scorpoid.notes: Offensive appendages. Claws are natural weapons.

serpentine_hybrid.name: Serpentine Hybrid
serpentine_hybrid.notes: Flexible. Can constrict. No leg slots. Tail may occupy unique slot.

quadruped.name: Quadruped
quadruped.notes: Strong endurance. Manipulation limited without Tool User trait.

theropod.name: Theropod
theropod.notes: Manipulation limited. Small arms may not hold standard weapons.

serpentine.name: Serpentine
serpentine.notes: Can coil. No manipulation. No standard equipment slots.

chelonian.name: Chelonian
chelonian.notes: Natural armor from shell. Shell occupies back/torso region.

molluscoid.name: Molluscoid
molluscoid.notes: Variable appendage count. Tentacles can manipulate multiple objects.

crustacean.name: Crustacean
crustacean.notes: Heavy natural armor. Claws as natural weapons.

pisciform.name: Pisciform
pisciform.notes: Must remain in water or have Amphibious trait. No leg slots.

cetacean.name: Cetacean
cetacean.notes: High aquatic speed. Limited surface capability without traits.

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.notes: Poor ground mobility. Aerial dominant. Wings replace arms.

true_dragon.name: True Dragon
true_dragon.notes: Highly versatile. Six-limbed. Humanoid variant can use standard slots.

chimeric.name: Chimeric
chimeric.notes: Combine abilities of multiple types. Slots determined per species.

amorphous.name: Amorphous
amorphous.notes: Can pass through gaps. No standard equipment slots.

crystalline.name: Crystalline
crystalline.notes: Brittle RP drawback. Resistant to slashing; weak to blunt.

silverpeak_elf.name: Silverpeak Elf
silverpeak_elf.lore: Mountain-dwelling mystics blending magic and martial skill.
silverpeak_elf.gm_notes: Flexible build. Works in both magic and martial roles.

ironhide_minotaur.name: Ironhide Minotaur
ironhide_minotaur.lore: Guardians of ancient labyrinths and herders of colossal stonebeasts.
